meta.subtitle: What's open, what just shipped, and the locked decisions that shape the kit.
meta.summary: Open work, recent landings, and locked design decisions for oku.

blocks.summary: oku 1.0 is substantially shipped — 28 chart variants, full Markdown parity, asymmetric-friendly wide-screen layout, three-tree build (standalone / site / markdown), a chip-filtered + kanban-able table, a Mermaid catalog, and a per-page accent system. Open work is concentrated in two themes: chart interactivity reach (hover / pin / cross-series highlight across the long tail of chart types) and the html-doc → oku rename now landing across the package, kit CSS prefixes, JS globals, and event names.
bullets: Charts — interactivity reach: 12/28 variants have full tooltip + click-pin + hover-highlight today. The tier-2 / tier-3 long tail (donut, sparkline, gauge, radar, box-plot, bullet, slope, calendar-heatmap, ridgeline, sankey, network, scatter-matrix, parallel-coordinates, chord, geo) is the next batch.
Charts — visual quality: grouped-bar palette cycling, bubble legend deconfliction, quadrant label deconfliction, heatmap label / cell overlap, parallel-coordinates line thickness — all queued.

Charts — catalog: add a real line example (renderer already supports it), a classic pie type, multi-series defaults on the sparse single-series examples, and the 'Pick by family' rewrite with mini-renders per variant + intent-based family grouping.

Rename — locked aggressive (now shipped): the package, kit CSS prefixes, JS globals, custom event names, data-attrs, and custom element names all moved off the legacy 'html-doc' branding to read 'oku'. The bin/html-doc + html-doc console-script aliases keep working through the 1.x sunset window so existing automation doesn't break.
Mermaid — quality pass: trim cases on wide diagrams, font auto-fit for cramped layouts, font-color audit for explicit fill:# rules (dark-mode legibility).
Tables — per-column wrap: true config so long-content columns render multi-line instead of horizontal-scrolling.

blocks.title: Recent landings
blocks.lead: Highlights shipped in the current cycle. Full per-commit history lives in git log.

items: ext-ref host is no longer a navigation link — clicking pins the tooltip, period. The destination URL is a proper clickable domain inside the citation card; the duplicate Learn-more footer is hidden when the cite card already exposes its own link.

live-snippet enhancement guards · the four `closest()` selectors that previously read `html-doc-live-snippet` (a name the registry never used) now read `html-doc-snippet`. The copy / wrap / language-pill / line-number passes no longer overlap the snippet's shadow pre.
Source / render columns inside .example-pair align — render-side first-child gains a 24px top margin to match the 30px the source-side pre reserves for its language pill.
Pagefind via PyPI — `oku check` runs `python -m pagefind` first (bundled binary from the `pagefind[bin]` extra), falls back to system pagefind / npx. brew / npm install no longer required.
Diagrams + Tables · per-type and per-style headings promoted to h3 so they appear in page-toc (which walks h2 / h3 only).
Per-page metadata · run-on `compare-grid` rewritten as a chip-filtered table (Field / Group / Meaning) — one field per row, three filter chips for Display / Behavior / Top-level.
Last-updated demo · a live example block now sits alongside the JSON snippet so the reader actually sees the quiet italic meta line the prose describes.
Skill relocation · the previously-user-scoped html-doc skill now lives at ./skill/ in the repo, registered as `oku` via symlink to ~/.claude/skills/oku.
Reference split · charts.json, tables.json, diagrams.json nested under reference via meta.parent.
Tier 3 charts · sankey, network, scatter-matrix, parallel-coordinates, chord, geo.

Markdown parity · YAML front-matter, footnotes, definition lists, reference-style links, nested lists, sanitised inline HTML allowlist (a, code, em, strong, span, sup, sub, br, mark, kbd, samp, del, ins, abbr).
Tables · kanban / board view by default via view: 'board', drag-resize columns, word-wrap cells, compact icon view-toggle.
Wide-screen · symmetric widening (everything follows --content-width); breakpoints at 1500px / 1900px.
annotated-code · substring chip auto-place + tooltip via Prism-token-split-safe wrapping; multi-line tooltip position:fixed above the block, escapes ancestor clipping.
Lightbox · true fullscreen with wheel / pinch zoom + drag pan + keyboard, reused for image / chart / diagram / mermaid (interactivity-preserve still queued).

blocks.title: Locked decisions
blocks.lead: Each was an open question once; collected here so future contributors don't relitigate.

items: Project name = oku (Turkish 'read!'). The rename now reaches into the on-disk package (src/oku/), kit CSS prefixes (okt- / okc- / okd-), JS globals (__oku*), event names (oku:*) and data-attrs (data-oku-*) — not just the front-of-house CLI.

Legacy `html-doc` console-script: silent through 1.0 (still resolves); stderr deprecation note from 1.1; console-script removed in 2.0. Existing automation gets a sunset window; new references read `oku`.

GitHub remote stays at github.com/mmdemirbas/html-doc — the schema URL, the repo dir name, and external links keep pointing there until the upstream rename happens. The project, CLI, kit prefixes, and skill all read `oku`.
Layout = option A (centered document, four-mode content-width cycle: narrow / comfortable / wide / max).
Wide-screen widening is symmetric — every primitive follows --content-width. The earlier asymmetric prose clamp was retired.
Fullscreen uses CSS-transform pan/zoom on the inner stage (wheel zoom anchored at cursor, drag pan, pinch on touch, keyboard +/-/0/arrows). Not SVG-viewBox math.
Code / render pair = 2-column grid above 900px, stacked below. Tabs widget rejected — reader wants both at once.
Inline HTML allowlist over a full sanitisation pipeline. Allowed: a, code, em, strong, span, sup, sub, br, mark, kbd, samp, del, ins, abbr.
Tier 3 viz (sankey / network / scatter-matrix / parallel-coordinates / chord / geo) all ship as kit-native chart types — no third-party chart library.
Charts / tables / diagrams are sub-pages of Reference (meta.parent: 'reference').
ext-ref host is NOT a navigation link. Clicking pins the tooltip; the destination URL lives as a clickable domain anchor inside the citation card. One affordance per element.
Pagefind is a Python dep, not a system binary — `oku[search]` extra pulls `pagefind[bin]>=1.5` so the bundled Rust binary lives inside the project's venv.

blocks.title: Principles
blocks.lead: Reader-, author-, and maintainer-facing rules every change honours.

items: Single LEFT sidebar — TOC + site tree stacked. No right TOC, no mid-edge tab.
Visual-first authoring. Pros/cons → comparison-cards, metrics → kpi-grid, trade-offs → table-with-chips. Paragraph + bullets is the fallback, not the default.
Every fix pairs with a regression test. Browser-level fixes ship with a Playwright assertion or, at minimum, a numeric bounding-box check captured in the commit message.
Numbers in counters / badges only — no English words baked into the kit.
No demo sibling pages. Every example for a primitive lives next to its heading.
No process / round / historical references in docs — describe current behaviour, not how it got there.
Layout invariants are numeric, not eyeball — express the rule as a boundingBox / computed-style assertion or accept it isn't a rule yet.
